name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility for users with low vision or screen glare while keeping the design clean. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s worth it—users must never guess where focus is.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds—users with low vision or screen glare will lose the ring. A 2px ring with 20% inner glow survives those backgrounds but risks disappearing on low-contrast patterned ones. Settle it with a toggle: let users pick solid or glow, tested on 10 patterned backgrounds at 3 contrast levels.
